channel.title: Marin Independent Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Marin Independent Journal (marinij.com)

item.title: ACC men’s basketball: Cal knocks off Stanford 72-66, gets rare sweep of its rival
item.description: Cal closes in on its first 20-win season in nearly a decade while sweeping Stanford in the regular season for the first time since the 2009-10 season.

item.title: Sports Briefs: San Marin’s DeKeyrel wrestles way to State
item.description: San Marin High junior Catania DeKeyrel is heading to Bakersfield for the CIF State Girls Wrestling Championship. DeKeyrel, the MCAL and Redwood Empire champion, placed second at Saturday’s North Coast Section Championships.

item.title: Sports in Marin: Sunday, Monday
item.description: Sunday's local events: Women’s tennis: Fresno Pacific at Dominican, 10 a.m., San Rafael

item.title: San Rafael denies appeals against 17-story apartment tower
item.description: The 200-apartment project at 700 Irwin St. is moving forward after surviving three challenges against its approval.

item.title: Marin cyclists revive push for Alto Tunnel restoration
item.description: Advocates for the closed passage between Mill Valley and Corte Madera want the county to resume project studies initiated in 2001.

item.title: Larkspur-Corte Madera School District settles 2-year contracts
item.description: The members of two unions will receive 4.51% pay hikes plus bonuses in the first year and no increases in the second.

item.title: Spring training: Tony Vitello’s debut as SF Giants manager turns out to be a learning, winning experience
item.description: New Giants manager comes out of his first ever spring training game with some perspective following a 10-5 victory over the Seattle Mariners.

item.title: Boys soccer: Sher’s goal lifts Branson into section semifinals
item.description: The Branson School boys soccer team battled into the wind during the first half and got into the break not only without conceding a goal but having created the better chances against Kennedy (Fremont) in the North Coast Section Division IV quarterfinals.

item.title: Girls soccer: Terra Linda makes section semifinal stage for first time
item.description: The feel-good story of the winter playoffs has to be the Terra Linda High girls soccer team earning its first trip to the North Coast Section semifinals in school history.

item.title: Lion dance celebrates Lunar New Year
item.description: Lion Dance by the Marin Chinese Cultural Association to celebrate Lunar New Year held at Town Hall Plaza in San Anselmo.
